title: Relative ($τ$), Expanders, and Decay of Correlations for certain Expanding Maps
summary: Relative ($τ$) is equivalent to a statement that the sequence of Cayley graphs associated to group quotients $Γ_q=Γ/N_q$, $q\in\mathbb{N}$, form an expander family. There is a philosophy that expander graphs give rise to good mixing; for instance, one has exponential mixing for the geodesic flow uniformly the along a family of congruence covers of the modular surface, stemming from the symmetry in the $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$ action and the uniform spectral gap for the Laplacian.
